name: Make a Boat!
desc:
[💰] Buy blocks from conveyor!
[🔨] Place strategically to make a boat!
[🚀] Launch and sail thru infinite areas!
[🤑] Earn coins and purchase stronger, faster and better blocks!

[💖] Friends can build and sail together!

[📕] Select unique blocks from the conveyor, place them strategically, and launch your boat! Travel thru randomly generated obstacles and areas! Earn coins, buy better and faster blocks and collaborate with friends to build the ultimate boat! Will you make the best boat?
